title: Baked Earth Feast
description: A hearty and earthy dish featuring baked earth, quinoa, and a hint of baked goodness.

ingredients.name: baked earth seasoning
ingredients.notes: available at local health food store

instructions: Rinse the earth thoroughly and dry with a paper towel.
In a large bowl, mix together quinoa, baked earth seasoning, and 250ml of water.
Add the rinsed earth to the bowl and stir until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and bake for 45 minutes.
After 45 minutes, remove the dish from the oven and fluff the earth with a fork.
Serve hot, garnished with additional baked earth seasoning if desired.
